style.styleTitle: Personalised Snowman Scene Glass Christmas Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Bring festive charm to your Christmas tree with this personalised snowman scene glass bauble. Featuring a beautiful snowman winter scene design, this elegant glass bauble is perfect for adding a personal touch to your Christmas décor and creating lasting festive memories. Personalise this Christmas bauble with 2 lines of text, with up to 14 characters per line, making it a thoughtful personalised Christmas gift for family, friends or loved ones. Ideal for hanging on the Christmas tree or displaying around the home during the festive season, this personalised glass decoration is a lovely keepsake to treasure year after year. Please double-check your personalisation, as your text will appear exactly as entered. Material of the bauble is glass and is supplied with ribbon, ready to hang.
